summary: A classic low-level design round built as a small TypeScript library with no runtime dependencies, fully in memory (no database, no HTTP API, no UI). Stage 1: the domain model -- spots in three ordered sizes (small < compact < large) where each vehicle type has a smallest fit, guarded spot transitions, tickets with unguessable crypto.randomUUID ids, plate normalisation, an injected Clock, and two Strategy interfaces: AllocationStrategy (smallestFitFirst, the default that keeps large spots for trucks, and nearestFirst, the shortest walk) and PricingStrategy (HourlyPricing: integer rates in minor units, every started hour of the whole stay once over the grace period); every public lot method is synchronous and checks everything before changing state, so a ParkingError always means nothing changed. Stage 2: async entry and exit gates whose printer and barrier may fail or hang; the check-then-act race (two gates, one free spot; one ticket, two exits) is reproduced in test/gates.test.ts with naive gates and fixed with synchronous claims (reserve / confirm / cancel, beginExit / commitExit / abortExit) held across the await, a device timeout through withTimeout that aborts an AbortSignal (default 10 s), an Observer (EventQueue) with a delivery queue so a re-entrant listener cannot leave a display board on a stale count, and a FreeSpotIndex with one min-heap per size and lazy deletion (park is O(sizes x log spots), not benchmarked). Stage 3: payments through a FAKE provider only (FakePaymentGateway, no real money, no credentials): beginPayment / beginExit lock the ticket and fix the amount, chargeWithRetry reuses one idempotency key per lock on every retry (a decline is final, anything else is retried up to 3 times and then reported as PAYMENT_UNKNOWN), a PayStation and an optional card reader at the exit gate, the barrier rule inside the lot (commitExit refuses with PAYMENT_REQUIRED while anything is due), a pay-then-exit window (default 15 minutes, then only the extra time is charged), lost tickets (replacement ticket, penalty, payments kept, old id answers TICKET_REPLACED) and a daily cap of 1-24 hours per started 24 h. 171 tests pass (Windows, Node 20), including randomized invariant runs (500 synchronous steps x 5 seeds x 2 strategies against the stage 1 full scan; 400 steps x 5 seeds with 3 entry and 2 exit gates, devices settling in random order with 15% failures, and provider total charged == lot total recorded). Mutation checks: stage 1 18 of 18 caught, stage 2 37 all caught, stage 3 63 deliberate breaks with 61 caught at first; the 2 survivors (S24, S26) were test gaps, closed and caught now. Not implemented: persistence or multi-process claims, a real payment provider, refunds, reconciliation of PAYMENT_UNKNOWN, reservation expiry, ownership checks for lost tickets, per-entrance distances.

pitch.intro_30s: Maine ek parking lot ka low-level design TypeScript library ke roop mein banaya hai -- bina runtime dependency, sab in memory. Spot sizes, allocation aur pricing strategies, phir async gates: check-then-act race naive gates se reproduce kiya aur synchronous claims se fix kiya. Stage 3 mein fake payment provider ke through idempotent retries, pay-then-exit window aur lost ticket. 171 tests, aur stage 3 ke 63 mutation checks.
pitch.explain_2min:
LLD interview mein parking lot ka asli test follow-up questions hote hain: allocation rule badlo, pricing badlo, do gates ek saath, ticket kho gaya, payment fail ho gaya. Maine code aisa banaya ki har follow-up ek chhota, local change ho, aur har rule ka test ho.

Center mein ParkingLot class hai. Uske saare public methods synchronous hain aur pehle har check karte hain, phir state badalte hain -- toh ParkingError ka matlab hamesha 'kuch nahi hua'. Har error test poore lot ko before aur after compare karta hai. Jo policies lot-to-lot badalti hain woh Strategy hain: AllocationStrategy (smallestFitFirst default, nearestFirst) aur PricingStrategy (HourlyPricing). Paisa integer minor units mein hai, 5000 matlab 50.00, float kahin nahi. Time injected Clock se aata hai, toh tests ManualClock se time aage ya peeche kar sakte hain.

Stage 2 ka bug: gate ka printer aur barrier async hain. Obvious code -- spot free hai check karo, printer ko await karo, phir park karo -- mein do gates aakhri spot ke liye dono check pass kar lete hain aur dono barriers khul jaate hain. Maine yeh naive gates test file mein likh ke reproduce kiya. Fix: claim pehle, synchronously. EntryGate.enter pehle lot.reserve karta hai (spot reserved, plate taken), phir device ko await, phir confirm; fail ya timeout par cancel. Exit par beginExit ticket lock karta hai aur fee fix karta hai; copied ticket ko doosri gate par TICKET_BUSY milta hai.

Stage 3 mein payment bhi isi shape ka hai: lock, slow charge, record ya rollback. Har lock ko ek naya paymentKey milta hai jo har retry par same jaata hai, isliye lost response ke baad retry double charge nahi karta. Barrier rule lot mein hai: commitExit PAYMENT_REQUIRED deta hai jab tak kuch due hai. Provider sirf FakePaymentGateway hai -- real payment, database ya HTTP API is project mein nahi hai.
pitch.deep_5min:
Ek car ki poori zindagi, code ke order mein.

Gate par aana. EntryGate.enter('mh 12-ab 1234', 'car') sabse pehle lot.reserve call karta hai. reserve normalizePlate chalata hai (upper-case, spaces aur '-' hata ke, phir 1-12 letters ya digits), vehicle type check karta hai, plate ticketIdByPlate mein pehle se hai toh ALREADY_PARKED, aur kisi fitting size ka free.nearest() nahi mila toh LOT_FULL. Phir allocation.choose(vehicle, index). Strategy sirf decide karti hai kaunsa size; us size ka nearest free spot index deta hai. Lot strategy ke jawab ko bhi verify karta hai: undefined, taken spot, fit na hone wala spot ya doosre lot ka spot -- STRATEGY_BUG, aur lot unchanged. Saare checks ke baad hi mutation hota hai: randomUUID ticket id (counter guessable hota), spot.reserve, entry status 'reserved', plate map, aur sabse last mein changeFree jo event emit karta hai, taaki listeners poora hua change dekhein.

Device. Ab gate withTimeout ke andar device.issue(ticket, signal) ko await karta hai, default 10 s. Is beech doosri gate ko yeh spot free dikhta hi nahi, aur same plate ko ALREADY_PARKED milta hai -- uska printer chalta hi nahi. Device fail ho, synchronously throw kare ya timeout ho: lot.cancel, signal abort, aur DEVICE_FAILED cause ke saath. Timeout ke baad aaya late success kuch nahi badalta (tested).

Confirm. Success par lot.confirm: spot reserved se occupied, status active. Entry time reservation ka time hai, wahi jo printed ticket par hai.

Pay station. Do ghante baad driver PayStation.pay karta hai. beginPayment ticket lock karta hai (status 'paying'), bill fix karta hai, kuch due nahi toh NOTHING_DUE, aur ek fresh paymentKey deta hai. chargeWithRetry har attempt ko timeout ke saath chalata hai: decline final hai (PAYMENT_DECLINED), baaki har error 'outcome unknown' hai -- 3 attempts tak SAME key ke saath retry, beech mein 200 ms. Phir bhi fail toh PAYMENT_UNKNOWN: lock release, kuch record nahi. Paisa shayad kat gaya ho; yeh pata karne ke liye reconciliation chahiye, jo built nahi hai. Success par recordPayment wahi amount record karta hai jo lock ne fix kiya tha -- caller ka number kabhi nahi.

Exit window. Payment ke baad 15 minute (exitWindowMinutes) tak stay ko payment ke time par price kiya jaata hai, toh car tak chal ke jaane mein kuch extra nahi lagta. Window ke baad bill = fee(now) - paid, yaani sirf extra time. Yeh tabhi sahi hai jab lambi stay ki fee kabhi kam na ho -- pricing test isko har 7 minute par 3 din tak, cap ke saath aur bina, check karta hai.

Exit gate. ExitGate.leave pehle lot.beginExit karta hai: ticket lock ('exiting'), exitAt aur bill fix. Kuch due hai aur gate par card reader hai toh wahi idempotent charge aur recordPayment; reader nahi hai toh PAYMENT_REQUIRED. Phir device.open timeout ke saath. Koi bhi failure: abortExit, car andar, ticket valid. Payment ho chuka tha aur barrier fail hua toh payment recorded rehta hai, agli try kuch nahi maangti -- dono tries mein ek hi charge (tested).

Commit. commitExit dobara check karta hai ki due 0 hai, warna PAYMENT_REQUIRED. Yeh rule lot mein hai, gate mein nahi -- toh buggy gate bhi unpaid car ko bahar nahi nikal sakti (mutation P24 isi ko pakadta hai). Phir forget: spot.release (holder ticket chahiye), index.released, maps saaf, aur last mein event.

Sabse mushkil decisions. Pehla, mutex vs claim: mutex har gate ko sabse slow printer ke peeche serialise kar deta; synchronous claim is baat par tikta hai ki JavaScript ek synchronous block ke beech koi aur code nahi chalata. Yeh sirf ek Node process mein sach hai; kai processes mein claim database mein jaana chahiye (conditional UPDATE ya unique constraint), jo built nahi hai. Doosra, idempotency key per lock, per attempt nahi -- har retry par naya key classic double charge hai (mutation P2). Teesra, Observer queue ke saath: nested delivery mein re-entrant listener boards ko stale count par chhod deta. Chautha, lost ticket par replacement aur purana id dead (TICKET_REPLACED), kyunki 'lost' ka matlab chori bhi ho sakta hai.
pitch.architecture_walkthrough: src/types.ts: VehicleType aur SpotSize string unions, SMALLEST_FIT table, fits() ek comparison hai (sizeRank). src/spot.ts: ParkingSpot free / reserved / occupied, guarded reserve, confirm, transfer, release -- har transition holder ticket check karta hai. src/free-index.ts: FreeSpots interface (nearest(size)), MinHeap, aur FreeSpotIndex -- har size ka ek min-heap, lazy deletion, inHeap flags taaki duplicate entry na bane. src/allocation.ts: AllocationStrategy, fittingSizes, nearer, smallestFitFirst, nearestFirst. src/pricing.ts: PricingStrategy, HourlyPricing (rates validated aur copied, grace, dailyCapHours 1-24, INVALID_TIME). src/clock.ts: Clock, systemClock, ManualClock. src/events.ts: EventQueue -- Observer with a delivery queue, throwing listener reported via onListenerError. src/errors.ts: ParkingError with a code. src/parking-lot.ts: ParkingLot -- reserve / confirm / cancel / park, quote / billFor, beginPayment / recordPayment / abortPayment, beginExit / commitExit / abortExit / exit (attendant booth, cash), reportLost, lookups, availability, subscribe, private bill() jo exit window lagata hai. src/timeout.ts: withTimeout (AbortController, timer cleared in finally) aur sleep. src/gates.ts: EntryDevice, ExitDevice, EntryGate, ExitGate (optional gateway as card reader). src/payment.ts: PaymentGateway, PaymentRequest, PaymentDeclinedError, chargeWithRetry. src/fake-gateway.ts: FakePaymentGateway with scripted outcomes (approve, decline, fail, lose-response, hang), idempotent by key. src/pay-station.ts: PayStation. src/display-board.ts: DisplayBoard, availability() se start karke sirf events apply karta hai. src/demo.ts: ManualClock par scripted din. test/: 12 files, 171 tests, invariants.test.ts randomized runs.
difficult_decisions: Concurrency ke liye mutex nahi, synchronous claim: lot ke methods synchronous rakhe aur gates async device ka kaam do lot calls ke BEECH karti hain (reserve ... confirm/cancel, beginExit ... commitExit/abortExit). Mutex har gate ko sabse slow printer ke peeche line mein laga deta; check-await-act khud bug hai.

Strategy sirf do policies ke liye (allocation aur pricing), aur State, Factory, Singleton aur Level class jaan-boojh ke nahi: spot ke states ka apna behaviour nahi hai, vehicle bas plate + type hai, Singleton tests ko ek global lot share karwa deta.

Strategy ko list nahi, index diya: choose(vehicle, free) jahan free.nearest(size) min-heap hai. Strategy ab sirf kaunsa SIZE bolti hai; park O(spots) se O(sizes x log spots). Benchmark nahi kiya, claim sirf complexity ka hai.
Barrier rule lot ke andar (commitExit PAYMENT_REQUIRED), gate mein nahi: warna har gate aur uska har bug bina pay kiye bahar jaane ka raasta hota.
Idempotency key per lock, har retry par wahi; decline final, baaki sab 'unknown' -- aur aakhri attempt ke baad PAYMENT_UNKNOWN bola, 'failed' nahi, kyunki charge ho bhi chuka ho sakta hai.

Pay-then-exit ke liye alag 'paid until' state nahi banaya: window tak stay payment ke time par priced, uske baad fee(now) - paid. Yeh isliye sahi hai kyunki fee lambi stay ke saath kabhi kam nahi hoti, aur yeh 3 din tak test kiya.
biggest_challenges: Race ko pehle dikhana: test/gates.test.ts mein NaiveEntryGate aur NaiveExitGate likhe (check, await, act) aur FakeDevice jiski calls test settle karta hai. Ek free spot par dono printers chale aur doosri car barrier khulne ke BAAD LOT_FULL paati hai; ek ticket par do barriers khule. Mutation S1 (naive entry gate) 9 tests mein pakda gaya.

Nested event delivery se stale boards: agar listener event 1 par lot badle (jaise valet listener park kare), plain nested delivery event 2 ko baaki listeners tak event 1 se pehle pahuncha deti, aur board purane count par ruk jaata. EventQueue ke queue aur delivering flag se fix; re-entrant listener test ke saath, aur S12 (nested delivery) 2 tests mein pakda.

Stage 3 mutation run mein 2 survivors: S24 ('nearer' sirf level compare kare) isliye bach gaya kyunki 'same level' test mein compact spot large se pehle rakha tha -- sizes order mein lene se jawab luck se sahi aata. S26 (spot.transfer holder check na kare) bacha kyunki koi bhi transfer ko galat ticket se call hi nahi karta tha. Test mein large spot ko nearer rakha aur naya spot test likha; dono ab pakde jaate hain.

Lost-response double charge: provider charge kar de aur answer raste mein kho jaaye. FakePaymentGateway ka 'lose-response' outcome isi ko simulate karta hai. Har retry par naya key (mutation P2) 7 tests mein pakda gaya; randomized test end par check karta hai ki provider ka total charged == lot ka total recorded, aur payment ids unique hain.

Paid at the gate, then barrier failed: exit abort hota hai lekin payment recorded rehna chahiye, warna agli try dobara charge karti. abortExit payments ko chhoota nahi (mutation P11 ise 6 tests mein pakadta hai).
failure_scenarios: Entry device hang ho jaaye: 10 s (timeoutMs) ke baad signal abort, reservation cancel, DEVICE_FAILED; late success kuch nahi badalta. Lekin real device ko AbortSignal honour karna padega (timeout ke baad barrier na khole) -- real hardware is project mein nahi hai.
Gate ka process reservation ke beech crash ho jaaye: reservation kabhi clean nahi hoti, kyunki expiry sweep nahi hai. Device timeout hung device cover karta hai, crashed gate nahi.
Provider teeno attempts par saaf jawab na de: PAYMENT_UNKNOWN, lock release, kuch record nahi -- lekin paisa shayad kat gaya. Provider ke records se reconciliation chahiye, jo built nahi hai.
Exit gate par card decline: PAYMENT_DECLINED, retry nahi, abortExit, barrier band, car andar, kuch charge nahi.
Clock peeche chala jaaye: pricing INVALID_TIME deta hai, car parked rehti hai aur ticket baad mein kaam karta hai; lot unchanged.
Display board listener throw kare: onListenerError (default console.error) report karta hai, change khada rehta hai aur baaki listeners chalte hain; error handler bhi throw kare toh ignore.
improvements: Persistence aur multi-process: claims ko database mein le jaana (spot par conditional UPDATE ya unique constraint). Abhi sab ek Node process ki memory mein hai.
PAYMENT_UNKNOWN ka reconciliation: idempotency key se provider se poochna ki charge hua ya nahi, aur refunds. Abhi nahi bana.
Reservation expiry sweep, taaki crashed gate ka reserved spot aur plate hamesha ke liye atke na rahein.
Real payment provider ka adapter PaymentGateway interface ke peeche; real providers ki tarah declines ko bhi per key yaad rakhna (fake abhi nahi rakhta).
Distances per entrance: abhi 'nearest' matlab lowest level, phir lowest position, aur ek hi entrance hai.
Lost ticket ke liye ownership checks (documents, plate photo) model karna, aur bade lots par free-spot index ka asli benchmark -- abhi sirf complexity claim hai.

learning_path.concept: LLD approach and the Strategy pattern
steps: 1. Concept: LLD round mein classes aur responsibilities dikhani hoti hain, phir follow-ups ko chhote local change banana. Strategy = badalne wali policy ko interface ke peeche rakhna.

2. Project need: kaunsa spot (AllocationStrategy) aur kitna paisa (PricingStrategy) lot-to-lot badalte hain; lot sirf na badalne wale rules enforce karta hai (spot free, vehicle fits, ek plate ek ticket).
3. Code/API: allocation.ts mein choose(vehicle, free), smallestFitFirst aur nearestFirst; pricing.ts mein fee(vehicle, entryAt, exitAt); ParkingLot options mein allocation aur pricing.

4. Detail: lot strategy par bharosa nahi karta -- LOT_FULL pehle khud check, phir result undefined, taken, non-fitting ya doosre lot ka spot ho toh STRATEGY_BUG, lot unchanged. State, Factory, Singleton aur Level class jaan-boojh ke nahi use kiye (PLAN.md 'Decisions').
5. Demo: cd projects/17-parking-lot && npx vitest run test/allocation.test.ts test/parking-lot.test.ts -- 'uses a plugged-in strategy: nearest-first puts the car in the large spot'.
6. Interviewer next: EV charging spots ya 'nearest to THIS entrance' kaise add karoge, aur kaunsi class badlegi?

learning_path.concept: Money as integers and the pricing rules
steps: 1. Concept: paisa float mein nahi -- integer minor units (5000 = 50.00), warna 3 x 0.10 = 0.30000000000000004.
2. Project need: fee, payments, penalty, due amount sab add aur subtract hote hain; ek paisa ka farak bhi bug hai.
3. Code/API: HourlyPricing(ratesPerHourMinor, { graceMinutes, dailyCapHours }); lot ka checkedFee non-integer, negative ya NaN fee ko STRATEGY_BUG bolta hai.
4. Detail: grace tak free; uske upar poori stay ke started hours (70 min with 10 min grace = 2 hours); cap 8 par 25 h = 8 + 1 = 9 hours; exit entry se pehle = INVALID_TIME.
5. Demo: cd projects/17-parking-lot && npx vitest run test/pricing.test.ts -- 'never charges less for a longer stay (checked every 7 minutes over 3 days, with and without a cap)'.
6. Interviewer next: currency conversion ya fractional tax aaye toh rounding kahan aur kaise karoge?
1. Concept: check-then-act race -- check aur act ke beech doosra code chal jaaye toh check purana ho jaata hai. JavaScript single-threaded hai, lekin har await ek gap hai.
2. Project need: gate ka printer aur barrier async hain; do gates aakhri spot ya ek copied ticket par dono barriers khol sakti hain.
3. Code/API: lot.reserve / confirm / cancel aur beginExit / commitExit / abortExit; EntryGate.enter aur ExitGate.leave claim ko await ke paar hold karte hain.

4. Detail: reserve spot ko 'reserved' aur plate ko taken kar deta hai; beginExit ticket lock karta hai aur fee fix karta hai (TICKET_BUSY copy ke liye). Yeh sirf ek Node process mein safe hai; multi-process mein claim DB mein chahiye -- built nahi.
5. Demo: cd projects/17-parking-lot && npx vitest run test/gates.test.ts test/two-phase.test.ts -- naive gates wale do tests race dikhate hain, EntryGate/ExitGate wale fix.
6. Interviewer next: do Node servers ek Postgres share karein toh yahi claim SQL mein kaise likhoge?
1. Concept: Promise.race se deadline, aur AbortController se kaam karne wale ko batana ki ruk jao.
2. Project need: printer, barrier ya payment provider hang ho sakte hain; claim hamesha ke liye atka nahi rehna chahiye.
3. Code/API: timeout.ts withTimeout(work(signal), timeoutMs); gates default 10 s, chargeWithRetry har attempt par timeoutMs.
4. Detail: timeout par controller.abort() aur reject; finally mein clearTimeout (koi timer peeche nahi); async wrapper se synchronous throw bhi rejection ban jaata hai; late answer ignore.
5. Demo: cd projects/17-parking-lot && npx vitest run test/gates.test.ts -t 'hangs' aur npx vitest run test/payment.test.ts -t 'hanging gateway'.
6. Interviewer next: device AbortSignal ignore karke timeout ke baad barrier khol de toh kya hoga?
1. Concept: Observer -- lot change par subscribers (display boards) ko event bhejta hai, unhe jaane bina.
2. Project need: har (level, size) row ka free count boards par live; reserve, cancel aur exit par event (confirm aur beginExit count nahi badalte).
3. Code/API: events.ts EventQueue.emit / subscribe; lot.subscribe; display-board.ts DisplayBoard availability() se start karke sirf events apply karta hai.

4. Detail: emit change complete hone ke BAAD; re-entrant emit queue mein jaata hai aur current event sab tak pahunchne ke baad deliver hota hai; listener set ki copy per event; throwing listener onListenerError ko report, skip.
5. Demo: cd projects/17-parking-lot && npx vitest run test/events.test.ts -- 'a listener that parks a car in reaction to an event leaves every board correct'.
6. Interviewer next: listeners alag process mein hon (pub/sub) toh ordering aur lost events kaise sambhaloge?

learning_path.concept: Min-heap free-spot index with lazy deletion
steps: 1. Concept: binary min-heap -- top par sabse chhota number; lazy deletion matlab delete abhi nahi, jab top par aaye tab.
2. Project need: har park par har spot scan karna O(spots) hai; strategy ko bas 'is size ka nearest free spot' chahiye.
3. Code/API: free-index.ts FreeSpots.nearest(size), FreeSpotIndex.released(spot), entryCount(); spot number = lot ki nearest-first list mein index.

4. Detail: spot lena heap ko touch nahi karta; nearest() stale entries pop karta hai; released spot sirf tab push jab uski purani entry heap mein na ho (inHeap), toh heap kabhi spots se zyada entries nahi rakhta. Benchmark nahi kiya.
5. Demo: cd projects/17-parking-lot && npx vitest run test/free-index.test.ts -- 3000 random take / release steps brute-force scan ke against.
6. Interviewer next: lazy deletion ka worst case kya hai, aur indexed heap (decrease-key) kab better hai?

learning_path.concept: Idempotent payments: one key per lock, decline vs unknown
steps: 1. Concept: idempotency key -- same key = same payment; provider dobara key dekhe toh pehla result lauta de, dobara charge nahi.
2. Project need: network call ki normal failure lost answer hai; retry par naya key = double charge.

3. Code/API: payment.ts PaymentGateway.charge, chargeWithRetry (attempts 3, retryDelayMs 200); fake-gateway.ts FakePaymentGateway outcomes approve / decline / fail / lose-response / hang; pay-station.ts PayStation.pay.

4. Detail: beginPayment / beginExit har lock par fresh randomUUID paymentKey; decline = PAYMENT_DECLINED, no retry; baaki = retry, phir PAYMENT_UNKNOWN (paisa shayad kata, reconciliation built nahi). Fake reused key ko alag amount ke saath refuse karta hai. Koi real provider nahi.
5. Demo: cd projects/17-parking-lot && npx vitest run test/payment.test.ts test/money.test.ts -- 'lost response: the retry gets the same payment; charged once, recorded once'.
6. Interviewer next: PAYMENT_UNKNOWN ke baad customer ka paisa kat gaya ho toh reconciliation job kaise design karoge?

learning_path.concept: Barrier rule, pay-then-exit window and lost tickets
steps: 1. Concept: invariant ko sabse neeche, state ke owner mein rakho -- 'koi car due ke saath bahar nahi jaati'.
2. Project need: pay station, card reader wali gate, bina reader wali gate aur attendant booth -- sab ek hi rule follow karein.
3. Code/API: commitExit (PAYMENT_REQUIRED), recordPayment (locked amount only), private bill() (exitWindowMinutes default 15), reportLost (lostTicketPenaltyMinor), exit() booth cash payment.
4. Detail: window ke andar stay payment ke time par priced; baad mein fee(now) - paid; replacement ticket same stay aur spot, payments kept, purana id TICKET_REPLACED (chori ho sakta hai).

5. Demo: cd projects/17-parking-lot && npx vitest run test/money.test.ts -- 'after the window, only the extra time is charged' aur 'paid at the gate, then the barrier failed: the next try does not charge again'.
6. Interviewer next: fee kabhi kam ho sakti (jaise night rate) toh window wala formula kaise tootega?
1. Concept: example tests ke saath randomized runs jo har step ke baad invariants check karte hain; mutation testing = jaan-boojh ke bug daalo aur dekho koi test red hota hai ya nahi.
2. Project need: concurrency aur payment bugs specific interleavings mein hi dikhte hain; aur test suite khud kitna strong hai yeh prove karna.
3. Code/API: invariants.test.ts -- seeded mulberry32 rng, checkInvariants, expectedSpot (stage 1 full scan as oracle), FakePaymentGateway random outcomes.

4. Detail: 500 steps x 5 seeds x 2 strategies; 400 steps x 5 seeds with 3 entry + 2 exit gates, 15% device failures; har pending device call ke peeche claim; end par provider total == lot total. Mutations: stage 3 mein 63 breaks, 61 pehli baar pakde; S24 aur S26 test gaps the, ab closed.
5. Demo: cd projects/17-parking-lot && npx vitest run test/invariants.test.ts, aur npm test (171 tests). README.md ka 'Mutation checks' section padho.
6. Interviewer next: 'caught by exactly one test' wali list kya batati hai, aur Stryker jaisa tool kab use karoge?
